ambiguity: Independent source-supported definitions can be incomparable as written even when their selected operations may fit a new shared abstraction.
materiality: Representation and inference semantics: equivalent old definitions, members of a new broader definition, and experimentally interchangeable procedures are different claims.

contract.inputs: Immutable source-bound operation selections, independent pending proposals, recorded comparison fields/rationales and the current admitted catalogue.
contract.output: A new proposal covering exactly the same selections, followed by fresh independent source/utility review and normal publication checks.
not_inferred: old definitions are equivalent because a broader replacement exists

references.inspected: edc/schema_canonicalization.py: SchemaCanonicalizer.retrieve_similar_relations, llm_verify, canonicalize; local snapshot and pinned official raw source
references.adopt: Separate definition construction from canonicalization and candidate retrieval from the semantic decision.
references.adapt: Our recovery returns to the source material to revise definitions and independently review each membership.
references.reject: The exact-name bypass and immediate schema enrichment after no match do not provide the source/compatibility guarantees this atlas needs.

references.adopt: Keep exact, broader/narrower and related meanings distinct.
references.adapt: Replacing a draft with a newly reviewed abstraction is recorded as provenance, not an exactMatch assertion.
references.boundary: SKOS does not decide biochemical equivalence or validate experimental interfaces.

alternatives_rejected: Treat matching words or enzyme names as identity: loses whole-transformation boundaries.
Change unknown comparison fields to same: changes the claim without additional evidence.
Ask the same definition-only comparator repeatedly: does not give it the missing source evidence or permission to revise the representation.
Immediately retire old drafts when a new compiler proposes a merge: an unapproved proposal would replace already reviewed work.

implementation.scheduling: One source-backed reconciliation per connected component of unresolved pending comparisons after a batch; only components wholly owned by that batch. Explicit CLI also supports saved drafts.
implementation.scientific_work: Fresh curation compiler reads original sources and comparison ambiguities; fresh reviewer sees the new proposal and sources, without being instructed to adopt previous verdicts.
implementation.draft_replacement: Exact original selection coverage and all replacement decisions must pass current source/utility checks. Short transaction checks immutable records again before retiring the old pending drafts with a replacement pointer.
implementation.publication: Separate resumable gate; outside definitions, current catalogue and fresh comparison requirements still apply. No membership is admitted by draft retirement.
implementation.failure: An incomplete or unapproved replacement leaves parents active; failed replacement draft is archived as withdrawn. After replacement, unresolved publication stays pending and can be resumed.
implementation.bounds: One scientific reconciliation attempt per component per batch. Existing bounded comparison updates remain. No retry-until-success policy.

limitations: Fresh model sessions are not human expert validation; shared model errors remain possible.
The comparator's candidate retrieval recall is unchanged.
Recovery does not select new subgraph boundaries.
Whole-submission atomicity can still hold otherwise useful selections if a replacement review remains unresolved.
Large connected ambiguity components may need future partitioning; no scalability claim from this three-method test.
An execution failure after draft replacement can leave a reviewed pending replacement; the database keeps it for resumed publication.
